It Was Raining That Night (0.9) is coming out next week!
As mentioned in our other game, Seducing The Devil, we have streamlined our workflow and are now aiming for quicker releases.
Our latest update was released just 18 days ago, and the next one is going to mark our fastest turnaround time for a new update.
